decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a complete new air filter unit. The filter elements and accessories are included components.

items.material_name: 1.4571 stainless steel supply/exhaust air filter unit, DN 150 interfaces, ≥250 m³/h, F7 and H13 filters rated at 800 Pa burst pressure
items.description: Clear-water chamber unit with replaceable filters, differential pressure gauge, condensate drains, and wall brackets.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a new exterior ventilation louver, including its insect screen and duct adapter.

items.material_name: 1.4571 stainless steel exterior fixed-blade ventilation louver, ≥250 m³/h, DN 150 adapter, 40/45/25/2 mm Z-frame, for approximately 20 cm wall thickness
items.description: Rain-resistant, tamper-resistant louver with overlapping Z-blades at least 2 mm thick and removable 1 × 1 mm insect mesh.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of new pressure/vacuum relief valves. The branch and connection hardware are included.

items.material_name: Building pressure/vacuum relief valve, ±650 Pa (6.5 mbar), ≥300 m³/h, minimum 1.4301 stainless steel housing, DN 150 pipe branch
items.description: Maintenance-free valve assembly with stainless steel branch and either a flanged connection or an axial-restraint pipe coupling.
